question: Can a deterministic compiled local search that starts from an empty 32 x 32 grid reproduce the public 58-point no-isosceles result for AlphaEvolve Problem 59 under a fixed, declared iteration budget, with every result accepted only by two structurally independent exact oracles?
hypothesis: At a fixed budget of 1000000 ruin/repair iterations per trial, at least one of the 64 from-scratch trials with seeds 0..63 of the mirror-symmetric baseline solver (solver/solver.c) reaches a dual-verified 58-point set, with zero oracle disagreements. The hypothesis is rejected if 0 of 64 trials reach 58.
primary_metric: number of the 64 trials whose dual-verified cardinality reaches 58, reported with a 95% exact binomial interval; secondary metrics are best dual-verified cardinality, score distribution, wall and CPU seconds per trial, failure classes, and oracle disagreement count
baseline: From-scratch deterministic C99 solver (solver/solver.c), symmetric under y -> 31-y, one seeded invocation per trial. The public 58-point certificate from google-deepmind/alphaevolve_repository_of_problems issue 10 is the external target only and is never used as solver initialization.
trial_definition: One trial is one from-scratch seeded solver invocation in its own subprocess. Inner ruin/repair iterations are counted separately and are not trials.
cost_model: P0 runs only on the local machine with no provider calls, so its marginal cost is 0.0 USD. The 20 USD figure is the ceiling for the whole experiment; none of it is authorized in P0.
stop_condition: P0 stops after the single 64-trial gate. If the solver fails deterministic replay or the two oracles disagree, stop before the gate and preserve the failing fixture. If 0 of 64 trials reach 58, record a failed reproduction gate and stop without tuning on seeds 0..63. If at least one trial reaches 58, record a passed gate and stop; no 59-point record search is part of P0. If the gate would exceed 15 minutes of wall-clock time, lower the iteration budget and label the run a screening gate.
dual_verification_gate: A candidate is accepted only when the per-apex distance oracle (src/tripathy_experiment/no_isosceles.py) and the perpendicular-bisector oracle (src/tripathy_experiment/perpendicular_bisector_oracle.py) both accept it in the controller. Any disagreement is an infrastructure failure that is written to an artifact and makes the run exit nonzero.

dataset.name: AlphaEvolve repository Problem 59: no isosceles triangles
dataset.version: upstream commit 8f447457957deac61e28bf1676746f0753b3b2f8; public 58-point set_a from issue 10
dataset.license: Apache-2.0 upstream; provenance and hashes in benchmarks/upstream/PROVENANCE.json

reproducibility.iteration_budget_calibration: Chosen on off-gate seeds 1000..1015 only: about 13 seconds per trial with 8 workers on an Apple M5 Max. Wall time is measured per trial as a secondary quantity.
